tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// khrus lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bkru byab srung ba rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa dri ma kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ zhabs sen nor bu'i me long las// rab 'bar 'od kyi byin rlabs rgyun// grub pa kun gyi gtsug gtor rtser// 'bebs mkhas bla ma rnams la 'dud// rang bzhin ye nas dri bral yang*// tshur mthong sdig dang sgrib pa'i mun// zhi byed snang ba'i chab gtsang mas// bkru ba'i cho ga 'dir bshad bya// re zhig 'dir gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi legs byas la bar du gcod pa'i rgyu rkyen mtshams sbyor thams cad 'khrud pa'i slad du/ khrus la rab tu bsngags pa'i lha rnams kyi cho ga bri bar bya'o// de la gnyis te/ sgrub thabs so sor bshad pa dang*/ khrus chog spyir bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa bsgrub par 'dod pas/ gtsang sbra sngon du btang ste stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'khod/ lhag bsam bzang po dang ldan pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo sme brtsegs su gsal ba'i snying gar nyi dkyil la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang sme brtsegs gnyis su med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru ra tsā ya/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṅghā ya/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyā/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ badzra muḥ tshogs rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing ga'i 'od zer gyis don gnyis byas/

yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog dud ka zhal gsum gyi rtsa zhal dud ka g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba'i zhal gsum gyi re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum 'bar ba/ mche ba g.yas gtsigs pa/ sma ra smin ma me 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul sngon po lto ser gyis ga sha byas pa/ thod skam lnga'i cod pan dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag drug gis g.yas gyi dang pos rdo rje rgya gram/ gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga/ gsum pas rdo rje lcags kyu bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ gnyis pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gsum pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de rnams thams cad gyen du bsgrengs pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i dor stabs su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing*/ sku las mched pa'i me dpung 'bar zhing mched par gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ stobs po che la drag shul can// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba che// gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba po// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu len/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs/ me tog gi char 'bebs bzhin du ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs/ shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

chus lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying gar hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs la/ oṃ bhur ku ra ma hā prā ṇa ye bhurtsi bhurki bi ma le u tsuṣma kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bhurkuṃ ri li shu tharshad ṣa bi ma le u tsuṣma kro dhā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ci nus bgrang*/ thun bsdu tshe me long la has btab pa bzhin lha sngags la thim/ sngags sa bon la thim/ de 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag dge ba bsngo/ shis brjod bya'o// ༈ /rnam 'joms mthing ga bsgrub par 'dod pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs par gsal ba nas/ yongs su gyur pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ sme brtsegs su gsal ba gnyis su med pa yongs su gyur pa sogs kyi tshab tu/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes dang*/ de bzhin 'og ma rnams la'ang lha so so'i mtshan gnas bsgyur ba'o// yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg pa/ gsus khyim che zhing nywa sul rags pa/ gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i khro bo'i zhal nas khams gsum za bar byed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags bsgril nas skan sgra brdab pas srid pa gsum g.yo zhing 'gul ba/ ag tshom me dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i khrod nas rdo rje'i me stag 'phro ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshubs shing*/ smin ma 'khyog po la bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ rdo rje'i thod nyis rim du bcings pa'i ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzengs pa rta gdong gi ri langs pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rjes ma rungs pa'i snying la gzir zhing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/

sbrul chen po rigs lngas rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ se ral kha dang*/ do shal dang*/ gdu bu byas pa/ dar sngon pos stod g.yogs shing*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying gar hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs la gzungs ring dag par 'don/ mthar nyer bsdu/ dge bsngo/ bkra shis brjod par bya'o// ༈ /rnam 'joms ljang gu bsgrub par 'dod pas/ rang nyid skad cig nas/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang gu'i 'od zer gyis don gnyis byed pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang gu zhi ma khro spyan gsum mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la rin po che'i cod pan/ rna cha/ mgur chu/ do shal/ gdu bus brgyan pa/ lha yi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad dkris can/ 'od zer gyi pa ṭa'i khong na 'gying stabs kyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ nas/ yar lud pa las don yod grub pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying gar hūm̐ ljang gu la sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs te gzungs ring*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ rnam par 'joms pa gnyis ka la bstod pa 'di bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag ma gong bzhin no// ༈ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma bsgrub par 'dod pas/ rang nyid skad cig nas/ gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i bhrūm̐ dkar po'i 'od zer gyis don gnyis byed pa yongs su gyur pa las/

rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ston ka'i zla ba lta bu'i mdangs can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ zhal gsum gyi rtsa zhal dkar la sgeg cing zhi ba/ g.yas zhal gser gyi mdog can bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal utpa la sngon po lta bu mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ re re'ang spyan gsum ma/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ lhag ma gsum gyis padma la gnas pa'i 'od dpag med/ mda' dang*/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ lhag mas tshe bum dang*/ gzhu/ skyabs sbyin/ 'chi med kyi na chung lta bu'i lang tsho can/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i me tog sogs rgyan dang dar zab kyis mdzes pa/ pad zlar rdo rje skyil krung gis 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i dbus na brjid par gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ nas/ yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ snying ga'i cha smad du bhrūm̐ dkar po sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs te/ oṃ bhrūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// bstod pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa pa'i gtsug tor nas// byung ba'i dpal mo tshe dang nor// mchog gi dngos grub sbyin mdzad ma// rnam par rgyal mar phyag 'tshal bstod// gzhan sngar bzhin no// ༈ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub par 'dod pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ dkar po'i 'od zer gyis/ nas/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang las padma dkar po dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po'i 'od zer gyis don gnyis byed pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' ston zla ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i zur phud yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla phyed dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rin po che'i prog zhu can/ nor bu'i rgyan thams cad kyis spras zhing*/ dar la'i na bza' mnabs pa/

phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i dbus na brjid par bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ yig dkar po sngags phreng gi bskor bar dmigs te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya dag par bzla/ bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan rigs rnams thams cad kyi// khyab bdag mchog gi rdo rje sems// gang zhig dad par ldan pa la// grub gnyis myur du stsol la bstod// ces so// gzhan tshogs bsags nas nyer bsdu'i bar sme brtsegs las lha'i ming dang sku mdog phyag mtshan dang*/ rigs bdag dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ sngags sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnams so sor ma 'dres pas las gang 'dod bsgrub par bya'o// gnyis pa khrus chog spyir bshad pa la/ gtso bor byas pa khrus kyi cho ga dang*/ zhar byung du bsgrub pa rjes gnang gi cho ga gnyis las dang po ni/ slob ma'am yon gyi bdag po la phan gdags pa'i phyir bkru byabs bsrung gsum bya bar 'dod pas/ lha lnga po gang la brten nas bya ba de'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas rjes/ rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par/ rgyun babs kyi chu blugs/ lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas btab/ mgul chings dang kha rgyan btags la stegs bu gtsang mar bkod/ rdo rje'i gzungs thag 'dzin bzhin du/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba nag po med pa/ mgul pa ras bzang gis dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang du/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ dri lnga/

'bru lnga/ snying po lnga dang ldan pa'i lha'i chus bum pa'i sum gnyis gang ba'i nang du/ pad nyi la hūm̐ mthing nag gi 'od zer gyis don gnyis byed pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur/ gyi bar sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar thim zhing*/ sku las byung ba'i ye shes kyi chus bum pa gang par gyur/ sngags bzla/ mthar/ lha 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang gnyis med du gyur/ oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig bzla'o// de nas bsgrub bya mdun du bkug nas/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ gong gi sngags dang bcas tsham rngams bya'o// khrus bya/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ de yi ngang las lhar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ de nas bum pa thogs te/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// nas/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces bde legs su byed pa'i tshigs bcad rdzogs mtshams/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud rtsi thal sbyor la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed rnams kyi mthu dang byin gyi rlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma'am/ yon gyi bdag po che ge mo 'di'am/ 'di dag gi sarba pā paṃ bhyaḥshantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra/ sarba bighnan= sarba ro ge= sarba duṣṭ+wa na= sarba dzwa re= sarba u pa dra be= sarba gra he= sarba a kā la mṛ tyu= sarba dussa pna= sarba durni mitte= sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas pa'i chus spyi bo nas blugs pas mgrin snying thams cad khyab par bsam zhing*/ che ge mo'i/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad= gdon= nye bar 'tshe ba= dus ma yin par 'chi ba= 'khon= grib= byad= byur= skal ba ngan pa= ltas ngan pa=

rmi lam ngan pa= rgyal bsen gyi gnod pa= mtshan mo nag mo dang bdud kyi gnod pa= bkra mi shis pa= bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gdong sogs lus kyi cha shas bkru bar bya'o// de nas bsgrub bya'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rma bya'i sgro chun gyis byab cing*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bsngags pa yi// go 'phang nyid ni thob bya'i phyir// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma rungs pa// dgra dang bgegs kyang med par shog /mu stegs can las rgyal gyur cig /byang chub snying po ma thob bar// bdud sde bzhi yis mi thub cing*// pho nya mngags gzhug pho nya mo// bran la sogs pas bsrung bar shog /gcong rong g.yang la sogs pa dang*// gdon dang rims nad med par shog /ces pa'i tshig bcad sngon du 'gro bas/ sngar gyi sngags mtha'i shāntiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu/ a pa nā ya swā hā/ btags la byabs pas sdig sgrib thams cad sa 'og tu bzhugs par bsam/ de nas lha gang la brten pa de'i gzungs lan gnyis gsum 'don cing gzungs khrus bya/ gong bzhin lha gang yin pa der bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ srung ba'i 'khor lo yod na gdags/ med na lus kyi gnas so sor rdo rje rgya gram du 'jog cing sngags mthar/ rakṣa rakṣa btags pas bsrung bar bya zhing*/ shis brjod kyis mtha' brten no// ༈ /gnyis pa zhar byung du bsgrub pa rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ lha lnga po yin gyi bdag bskyed dang bum sgrub byas la/ mdun du maṇḍal mthar rdul tshon gyi padma 'dab brgyad lte ba ze'u 'bru mu khyud dang bcas pa'i dbus su lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i sa bon nam/ phyag mtshan nam/ tshon phung bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i zhes sogs bzlas pa'i mthar/ sngar bzhin gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gu can gyis drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ro nas/ swā hā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rjes su gnang ba don gnyer gyi slob ma dri bzang gi chus bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ bgegs gtor chab kyis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ 'dir rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa la 'jug pa'i bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad dang 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// tshim zhing dga' bar gyis la rang rang gi gnas su dengs shig oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bgegs bskrad/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ 'og dang steng dang phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin me 'od kyi phung por gyur/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer ma mchis pa'i spyan sngar rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba dang*/ gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen gzhom zhing mthun rkyen spel ba'i phyir du/ khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che sme ba brtsegs pa'i spyan sngar rig gtad rjes gnang gi rim pa zhu zhing nyams su len snyam pas ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de yang 'o skol rnams rnyed par dka' ba dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang zhing*/ 'khor lo chen po bzhi ldan gyi rten khyad par can 'di bde blag tu rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che rnam par dag pa dang mjal/ zin par dka' ba mtshan nyid kun ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis zin pa 'di mchog tu skal ba bzang bar 'khums/

rten de las mchog gi khang bzang du 'dzegs pa'i them skas bla na med pa lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba don du gnyer bar 'dug pa legs/ de las 'dir khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che sme ba brtsegs pa'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i skabs lags pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che sme ba brtsegs pa/ zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrigs par gyur/ zhes gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi sdom pa len snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang dngos gzhi zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// brtse chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus bka' drin rjes gnang stsol// lan gsum/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ khyed rang rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ de'i ngang las sme brtsegs su gong bzhin bskyed/ de'i spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams nas sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa sme brtsegs kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad nas/ spos btul/ dril bu drag tu dkrol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bkra shis glu len sogs nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas/ oṃ āḥbadzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

de ni sku'i rjes gnang ste/ des lha bsgom du rung ba'i skal ldan du byas/ de nas yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon sme brtsegs su gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*/ khyed rang sme brtsegs su gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ bhurkuṃ sogs kyi rjes zlos lan gsum/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bkod la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nus pa brtan par mdzad du gsol// de nas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ de ni gsung gi rjes gnang zhes rig pa gtad pa ste/ des sngags bzlar rung ba'i skal ldan du byas/ de nas dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar sems rang babs su zhog mdzod/ de ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ste/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom du rung ba'i skal ldan du byas/ tshom bu lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu ba khyed rang la thim pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshom bu spyi bor bkod cing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ des sme brtsegs dud ka'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ de'i dam tshig thams cad ma nyams par bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// sogs lan gsum gyi mthar/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul lo// des mtshon nas lha sngags sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos kyi 'dor len shes par byas nas/ lha gzhan la yang rgyas gdab/ lha gcig gi rjes gnang yin na 'di bzhin dang*/ thun gcig la gnyis gsum nas mang po'i bar ji tsam byed kyang*/ lha snga ma de'i bdag bskyed ngang nas bum mdun so sor bsgrub/

rjes gnang gi tshe snga ma la gsol gdab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngar bzhin dang*/ gnyis pa man la/ dper na slob dpon sme brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms par gsal thob la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// zhes sogs dang*/ slob ma lhar bskyed pa'i dus kyang*/ khyed rang rnams sme brtsegs su gsal ba yongs su gyur pa las sogs gong bzhin rigs 'gre/ slob ma gcig yod na khyed rang*/ gnyis yod na khyed rang rnams/ gsum phan la khyed rnams zhes shan 'byed pa dang*/ khrom chen po la me tog rgyang nas 'thor ba sogs dus skabs dang mthun pa'i khyad par gal che ba ni chos nyid do// rnon por zur gyis go ba'i brda 'os kyang*// brtul la de yi rjes phyin go dka' bas// gti thug khrigs su bris pa'i dge ba 'dis// khrid sgo bla ma'i zhal gdams mdzes gyur cig /'gro ba la phan gdags pa'i phyir yi ger gsal bkod 'di nyid gzhan don gtsor mdzad kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ grong chog nyul bzhed kyi mchod gnas 'ga' yi dgongs pa bskang ba'i phyir/ bya bral buddha'i ming gis rgyal po'i pho brang gi lha zhol bde gshegs khang gsar du bris pa'o// //dzayantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
